sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Figures
sequence_points.description: A blurred abstract painting featuring indistinct human figures in a dimly lit setting, dominated by dark tones and soft color gradients. The artwork is mounted on a wall within a museum exhibit space.

sequence_points.name: Dancer in Motion
sequence_points.description: A dynamic ink painting depicting a dancer mid-leap, rendered in expressive black and gray brushstrokes against a white background. The figure is stylized with flowing lines, and the composition includes calligraphic inscriptions and a red seal in the lower left corner.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Earth Tones
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract painting featuring a blend of earthy browns, muted greens, and dark tones, with textured brushwork suggesting layered forms. The artwork is mounted on a wall in a museum setting, framed by a simple dark border.
